title: Convert query.rs to query/mod.rs
problem: src/execution/query.rs is one of the largest database-core files and blocks further query submodule extraction.
approach: Create src/execution/query/ as a module directory.
Move src/execution/query.rs to src/execution/query/mod.rs without semantic edits.
Keep src/execution/mod.rs using mod query; so call sites remain unchanged.
risk_controls: No helper extraction in this task.
Run cargo check --lib and show-related SQL integration tests.
